trials.claim: All future Company or Enterprise Plan updates included
trials.claimQuote: All future Company (Tiers 1-2) or Enterprise (Tiers 3-7) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: A buyer says they hope SMS integration will be made available to AppSumo purchases, implying this new feature is not currently included despite the promise of all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: I hope SMS integration option is directly made available into Appsumo purchases (at least the highest 2 tiers).
exhibits.argument: Quote shows a new integration is not included for AppSumo purchases, undermining all future updates included.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers grandfathered into new features and limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
trials.reasoning: A buyer hopes SMS integration will be made available to AppSumo purchases, suggesting previous AppSumo customers were not automatically grandfathered into that new feature.

exhibits.quote: I hope SMS integration option is directly made available into Appsumo purchases (at least the highest 2 tiers).
exhibits.argument: Quote shows previous AppSumo customers are not automatically grandfathered into the new SMS feature.

trials.claim: Store built with 1,500+ native features requiring no plugins or coding
trials.claimQuote: Build, manage, and scale your online store with 1,500+ native features—no plugins or coding required
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms marketplace, POS, CMS, subscriptions and other core capabilities are all native with no add-ons or plugins, and the vendor describes the builder as no-code. Missing bundle and local tax features do not disprove the 1,500+ native-feature or no-plugin claim.

exhibits.quote: There is no native product bundle feature to combine multiple items into a single kit with individual product inventory tracking.
exhibits.argument: Quote directly reports a missing native feature, contradicting the 1,500+ native features with no plugins needed claim.

exhibits.quote: They don't support sales tax calculations on a local level (City or zip code) only as far as the State level and that won't work for some States, including California.
exhibits.argument: Quote reports missing native local sales-tax calculation, undermining the no-coding complete native features claim.

exhibits.quote: Marketplace builder, POS, CMS + blog, subscriptions, digital file delivery, affiliates and discounts — all native. No add-ons, no plugins.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms many core commerce capabilities are all native with no add-ons or plugins required.

exhibits.quote: Build it yourself with a no-code, no-expert-needed solution built for millions of orders.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the solution is no-code and needs no expert to build it yourself.

trials.claim: Launch on custom domain with cloud hosting, SSL and CDN included
trials.claimQuote: Launch on your own custom domain with cloud hosting, SSL certification, and CDN (content delivery network) included
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms building a store with a custom domain and SSL on the platform. Needing support guidance for a domain/SSL issue does not show those features were not included.

exhibits.quote: When I ran into a domain/SSL issue, he responded incredibly fast in the support chat and pointed me in exactly the right direction (Cloudflare integration) to get it sorted.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows custom domain with SSL required external Cloudflare integration work, undermining that SSL is included.

exhibits.quote: After actually building things out, products, categories, discount codes, custom domain with SSL, page builder, product variants and SKUs I've been really impressed by how much this platform can do!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms they built out a store using custom domain with SSL on the platform.

trials.claim: Publish and manage content with built-in CMS and blog
trials.claimQuote: Publish and manage content natively with a built-in CMS (content management system) and blog
trials.reasoning: A buyer directly confirms the platform includes a native CMS and blog with no add-ons or plugins.

exhibits.quote: Marketplace builder, POS, CMS + blog, subscriptions, digital file delivery, affiliates and discounts — all native. No add-ons, no plugins.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms CMS plus blog is included natively in the platform.
